text:
alex: Holding the promo — staging smoke worker keeps hitting a hard timeout and deploy-bot keeps retrying the canary.

deploy-bot: Canary promotion paused (policy: smoke-fail). 3 failures in last 10m. Auto-retries exhausted.

sam: link: https://ci.internal.redwood/test/1423 shows the failing job. Any quick logs?

alex: paste logs from the failing job:
```
[2026-03-20T15:02:11Z] smoke-worker-17 | ERROR TimeoutError: Worker did not respond within 300s
[2026-03-20T15:02:11Z] smoke-worker-17 | Running: tests/integration/test_end_to_end.py::test_session_restore
[2026-03-20T15:02:10Z] smoke-worker-17 | Memory usage spike: RSS 2.8GiB -> 5.1GiB
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/usr/src/app/runner.py", line 78, in run_test
    result = pytest.main([test_path, "-q"])
TimeoutError: Worker timeout
```

maria: Hmm looks like a memory/regression in the smoke runner image. We could pin the canary to last-good image and manually promote that while we investigate.

jun: Agreed. Do we know which image was last-good? ops metrics show no OOMs on v2026-03-10 image.

linda: Oncall saw a scheduler spike around the same time — a batch job consumed extra GPUs in eu-west for ~6m. Might have pushed runners into noisy-neighbor OOMs.

paul: Two options:
- Manual promote previous image (fastest) OR
- Rerun smoke on fresh runner pool (might still hit noisy neighbor if not isolated)

sam: If we manual-promote we should add a release note: "Pinned canary to v2026-03-10 due to staging smoke worker timeout; investigation ongoing." Keep change window in mind — next change window is 45m.

alex: Command to manual promote:
```
# from release engineer laptop
deploybot promote --env staging --image gcr.redwood/release:2026-03-10 --reason "pin after smoke timeout" --manual
```

maria: +1 for pin and manual promote. Then re-run smoke on a quarantined runner pool for debug. I'll open a follow-up ticket.

jun: Can we also collect heap profiles from a repro run? If memory spike is real we should attach to the ticket.

linda: I'll pin nodepool to dedicated runners for the debug run. Will post pool id shortly.

paul: I'll draft the short release note blurb and keep the promo on hold until alex confirms manual promote succeeded.

alex: Doing manual promote now. Will update here with deploy-bot status.

deploy-bot: Manual promotion requested by alex. Starting promote job #promote-8842.

deploy-bot: Promotion succeeded: staging-image -> gcr.redwood/release:2026-03-10. Canary resumed on pinned image.

alex: Smoke on pinned image passed (3/3). Unholding promo and proceeding with scheduled change window.

paul: Release note: "Temporary pin to gcr.redwood/release:2026-03-10 for staging after transient smoke worker timeouts; full root-cause investigation in ticket RD-4127." Will attach logs.

maria: Thanks everyone. I'll kick off the quarantined repro and heap dump capture.

alex: :thumbsup: will watch RD-4127 and remove pin when fixed.
